items.item:
1. A configuration with some service tokens but without Client Portal's
   stops the start and names the missing item; one with none of the four
   and no service API address is an owner-only start.
   Shows A17-1. [witness: verification:registry_a17_missing_token_stops_start_none_owner_only]

verdicts.item:
1. A configuration with some service tokens but without Client Portal's
   stops the start and names the missing item; one with none of the four
   and no service API address is an owner-only start.

quotes: assert diagnostic is not None, f"start passed; expected it to name {item}"
verdicts.why: The selected test detects a configuration missing Client Portal's token, requires a diagnostic naming that item, and verifies that no configured listener serves. It also verifies that omitting all four tokens and the service address permits an owner-only start while leaving the service listener closed.
